help.label: Help
help.title: About this demo
help.body: This portal is a demonstration with synthetic patient data. It is not for clinical use. Rule flags come from illustrative demo rules that are not clinically validated.
help.roles: Demo personas show what each role can do. Switching persona is demo only — it is not authentication.
help.tools: Use Demo tools in the top bar to reset data, load a scenario or simulate network problems.
